decisions.name: 李香琴
decisions.reason: Visual inspection confirms the photograph depicts a displayed opera costume on a stand with background display boards, not the performer. Filename contains artist's name but image has no face.

decisions.name: 秦沛
decisions.reason: Visual inspection confirms a wide Causeway Bay street/minibus scene. No sufficiently visible, recognizable individual face; source caption name is not proof the actor is visually identifiable.

decisions.name: 田蕊妮
decisions.reason: Visual inspection confirms sharp single face with all features. v1 reveal cut eye/nose/lip; v2 five-stage fully visible. Commons source says am730 YouTube interview CC BY 3.0, independently license-reviewed by Techyan on 2019-09-15; Wikimedia depicts Kristal Tin, Wikidata Q6437706 P18. See separate exact-SHA visual-reviewed record.

decisions.name: 陳錦鴻
decisions.reason: Visual inspection confirms person holding a microphone directly at mouth, source only 268x401 pixels. Mouth stage would be obstructed and 600x720 upscale low quality.

notes: The three rejected source images must not be reused as portraits or counted; seek new originals.
The approved v2 crop is not automatically live: integrate on review branch and require Singer Mobile QA, Verify work hints, Pages build/live QA and public JSON check.
